descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Control Tower VR puts you in the role of an air traffic controller in full 3-dimensional space. Draw flight paths to guide aircraft safely to their runways while avoiding other aircraft and obstacles in the environment.

Five types of aircraft must be managed: commercial airliners, private planes, gliders, helicopters, and zeppelins. Each behaves differently, for example, gliders cannot climb unless they are inside an updraft.

The game features two modes: Play Now and Career.

Play Now offers open-ended gameplay where you land as many aircraft as possible while the difficulty gradually increases.

Career mode is also open-ended but challenges you to reach target scores to earn medals and unlock new maps. It introduces special scenarios such as UFOs attacking your planes or aircraft that must fly past points of interest before landing.

Both modes feature five different maps, each presenting its own unique challenges.
